content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-414. - Public information.
content.summary:
Each disclosure statement, amended statement or a notification that no amendment is
               required shall be public information available in the city clerk's office to any person
               upon request during normal working hours.
(Code 1960, § 2-3.4(d); Code 1981, § 2-6)
